title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Chargers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 11
items.desc: The Chargers D/ST allowed 27 points while notching one sack in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Los Angeles was unable to slow down the Jets' offense in the close loss. Their lone sack came from Troy Dye. The Chargers will now face off against the Patriots in Week 12. They will not be a recommended streaming option, despite the Patriots having to start Tommy DeVito at quarterback following Drake Maye's multi-week ankle injury.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Cameron Dicker makes one FG in Week 11
items.desc: Cameron Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt and added three extra points in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Dicker hit a 52-yard field goal on his only attempt. The veteran kicker has made 19 of his 21 field-goal attempts and added 15 extra points this year. He will face the Patriots in Week 12.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: David Njoku catches two passes in Week 11
items.desc: David Njoku caught two of his four targets for 21 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Njoku left the game briefly to get his shoulder checked out but was able to return to action. The veteran tight end is part of a three-man rotation with Charlie Kolar and Oronde Gadsden II, which will limit his upside going forward. He will not be a recommended fantasy option heading into Week 12 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Charlie Kolar catches one pass in Week 11
items.desc: Charlie Kolar caught his lone target for an eight-yard gain in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Kolar was quiet in the close loss. The Chargers are playing three tight ends now that David Njoku is healthy, which will limit Kolar's upside. He can remain on waivers in Week 12 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Oronde Gadsden II held catchless in Week 11
items.desc: Oronde Gadsden II did not draw any targets in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Gadsden was invisible while David Njoku drew four targets. The former will be hard to trust moving forward, especially with Njoku in the fold. The Chargers will face the Patriots in Week 12.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Quentin Johnston catches one pass in Week 11
items.desc: Quentin Johnston caught one of two targets for nine yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Johnston was quiet in the close loss, which has been far too common this season. He has caught exactly one pass in five of his past six games, as the Chargers have not prioritized getting Johnston the ball this season. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 12 vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ladd McConkey hauls in two TDs in Week 11
items.desc: Ladd McConkey caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: McConkey returned from a one-game absence to bring in two TD passes from Justin Herbert in the close loss. The veteran wideout has now caught 22 passes for 323 yards and three touchdowns this season. He will take on the Patriots in Week 12, although Herbert is unlikely to play after suffering a concussion late vs. the Jets.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Tre' Harris goes for 28 yards in Week 11
items.desc: Tre' Harris caught both of his targets for 28 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Harris had a big game in Week 10 with Ladd McConkey sidelined but he took a backseat in Week 11 with McConkey back in uniform. The veteran wideout has caught 28 passes for 376 yards in nine games this season. He will now prepare to face the Patriots in Week 12.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Keaton Mitchell leaves Week 11 loss early with injury
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell caught a six-yard pass and did not record a carry in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: It was a rough afternoon for Mitchell, who left the game briefly with a back injury before returning. He then injured his knee and did not come back into the game. Mitchell has been playing far behind Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal of late. His playing status is in jeopardy heading into a Week 12 matchup vs. the Patriots.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kimani Vidal rolls up 54 all-purpose yards in Week 11
items.desc: Kimani Vidal carried the ball seven times for 36 yards and caught both of his targets for 18 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Vidal was productive in the close loss, averaging 5.1 yards per carry behind starter Omarion Hampton. Vidal could be in line for a larger role moving forward as Keaton Mitchell missed time in Week 11 with back and knee issues. The Chargers will now prepare to face the Patriots in Week 12.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Omarion Hampton runs for 89 yards in Week 11
items.desc: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards while catching a four-yard pass in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: After splitting work pretty evenly for much of the season, Hampton has taken over the Los Angeles backfield over the past two weeks. He has seen 36 of the 48 running back carries over the past two games as the Chargers have made it a point to get him going on offense. Hampton is shaping up as a low-end RB2 in fantasy for the rest of the season with the Patriots up next in Week 12.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Justin Herbert throws two TDs, suffers concussion late in Week 11 loss
items.desc: Justin Herbert completed 15 of his 21 passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns while adding eight rushes for 32 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
items.impact: Herbert tossed a pair of touchdowns to Ladd McConkey while adding a 10-yard rushing touchdown in the close loss. He suffered a concussion late in the game and entered the league's concussion protocol after the contest ended. He is unlikely to play in Week 12 vs. the Patriots, putting DJ Uiagalelei in line to make the start. Uiagalelei has completed two of his seven pass attempts this season for 24 yards and a touchdown. Stay tuned to the Chargers' practice reports this week.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jets D/ST allows 24 points in Week 11 win
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 24 points while picking up six sacks in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: New York's defense was unable to force any turnovers but they notched an impressive six sacks vs. Justin Herbert. The Jets were led by David Bailey, who contributed a pair of sacks. The Jets will be a solid fantasy streaming option in Week 12 vs. a struggling Kyle McCord and the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jason Sanders hits two FGs in Week 11
items.desc: Jason Sanders made both of his field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Sanders was perfect in the close win, adding field goals from 50 and 24 yards out. The veteran kicker has hit 27 of his 30 field-goal attempts and 16 extra points this year. He will now get ready to take on the Dolphins in Week 12.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq finishes with three catches in Week 11
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Sadiq tied for second on the team in receiving in a game where the Jets went run-heavy. The rookie tight end has gone over 22 receiving yards just three times this season. Sadiq will be a low-end TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Sterling Shepard catches two TDs in Week 11
items.desc: Sterling Shepard caught both of his targets for 24 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Shepard was elevated from the practice squad on Saturday and promptly went on to catch two touchdown passes from Geno Smith in the close win. The Jets were in need of his services, with Omar Cooper Jr. missing the game with an ankle injury and Isaiah Williams (ribs) also sidelined. It remains to be seen if Shepard will stick on the active roster even after Cooper and Williams are ready to return.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Mason Taylor catches two balls in Week 11
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught both of his targets for 25 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Taylor finished fourth on the Jets in receiving in the close win over the Chargers. He continues to split opportunities with Kenyon Sadiq for the Jets, posting 24 catches for 192 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this year. He will be on the TE3 radar in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Adonai Mitchell goes for 30 yards in Week 11 win
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell caught two of his three targets for 30 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Mitchell tied for second on the team in receiving in a game where the Jets went very run-heavy to beat the Chargers. The veteran wideout now has 21 catches for 354 yards and one touchdown in seven games this season. He will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 12 against the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Garrett Wilson leads Jets in receiving in Week 11
items.desc: Garrett Wilson caught three of his five targets for 39 yards in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Wilson's modest yardage total was good enough to lead the team in a game where the Jets only attempted 21 passes and threw for 176 yards. Wilson has been a bit boom/bust this season, but he remains a solid fantasy WR2, posting 53 catches for 672 yards and three touchdowns in 10 games. He will be a solid option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Braelon Allen runs for 75 yards in Week 11
items.desc: Braelon Allen carried the ball 16 times for 75 yards and caught a nine-yard pass in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Allen and Breece Hall combined for 151 rushing yards in the close win over Los Angeles. Allen continues to see a solid workload despite sharing time with Hall, giving both running backs standalone fantasy value. He will be a flex option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Breece Hall finds the end zone in Week 11
items.desc: Breece Hall carried the ball 20 times for 86 yards and caught all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Hall found the end zone for the first time since Week 1 vs. the Titans on a seven-yard reception in the second quarter. The veteran running back has 560 all-purpose yards and two TDs in six games this season. He will be a strong fantasy play in Week 12 against the Dolphins.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Geno Smith tosses three TDs in Week 11 win
items.desc: Geno Smith completed 17 of his 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns while adding a four-yard run in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11.
items.impact: Smith was efficient in a game where the Jets leaned on the rushing attack to defeat the Chargers. Better yet, he showed no lingering effects of the ankle injury he suffered in Week 10. Two of his TDs went to Sterling Shepard, while the third went to Breece Hall. Sitting on 15 touchdowns and three interceptions this season, Smith will be a QB2 in fantasy in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cowboys D/ST records five sacks Sunday
items.desc: The Cowboys defense allowed 30 points on 346 total yards with five sacks and one fumble recovery on Sunday against the Titans.
items.impact: Dallas had some success getting to Cam Ward on the day. They still remain well off the fantasy radar as a defense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brandon Aubrey makes lone field goal Sunday
items.desc: Brandon Aubrey made his lone field goal on Sunday.
items.impact: Aubrey was busy with six extra point attempts. His lone field goal came from 49 yards out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brevyn Spann-Ford catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Brevyn Spann-Ford caught 2-of-2 targets for five yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Spann-Ford saw some more opportunity with Jake Ferguson sidelined. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Flournoy quiet Sunday
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy caught his lone target for 11 yards in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
items.impact: It was an unusually quiet day for Flournoy in a game where the Cowboys scored over 50 points and Dak Prescott tossed four touchdowns. He is an upside WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Pickens catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: George Pickens caught 7-of-10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Pickens and CeeDee Lamb each saw double-digit targsts, exceeded 100 yards receiving and hauled in touchdowns on the day. Pickens remains a borderline WR1/WR2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CeeDee Lamb hauls in 11 passes Sunday
items.desc: CeeDee Lamb caught 11-of-12 targets for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Lamb had one of his vintage huge performances in a shootout win for Dallas.  He remains a locked and loaded WR1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jashaun Corbin sees five carries Sunday
items.desc: Jashaun Corbin ran for 32 yards on five carries in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Corbin was elevated from the practice squad to backup Javonte Williams. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javonte Williams finds the end zone twice Sunday
items.desc: Javonte Williams ran for 67 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 24 yards receiving and another score.
items.impact: Williams wasn't super efficient on the ground, but it didn't matter with the volume he saw to go along with two carries. He remains an RB1 for fantasy managers in a workhorse role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dak Prescott totals five touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Dak Prescott completed 28-of-33 passes for 325 yards and four touchdowns in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
items.impact: Prescott added a fifth touchdown on the day on the ground. He tossed touchdowns to CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens, Javonte Williams and Brevyn Spann-Ford through the air. He'll face the Eagles next on Thanksgiving.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Titans D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Titans defense allowed 51 points on 480 total yards on Sunday against the Cowboys.
items.impact: The Titans defense remains well off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Slye makes all six kicks Sunday
items.desc: Joey Slye connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Slye made field goals from 38, 48 and 28 yards out. It was a big day for the Titans offense against the Cowboys defense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gunnar Helm hauls in two passes Sunday
items.desc: Gunnar Helm caught 2-of-3 targets for 14 yards in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Helm remains a touchdown dependent TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elic Ayomanor quiet Sunday
items.desc: Elic Ayomanor caught 3-of-3 targets for 27 yards in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: After Ayomanor had a big performance last week, it was Chimere Dike this time around for the Titans with Carnell Tate back and healthy. He remains a volatile WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Calvin Ridley finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Calvin Ridley caught 5-of-6 targets for 68 yards and a touchdown in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Ridley had recorded only six catches for 91 yards on the season entering Sunday. Despite this performance, he remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chimere Dike hauls in six passes Sunday
items.desc: Chimere Dike caught 6-of-7 targets for 69 yards in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Dike led the team in targets, receptions and receiving yards on the day. He has been able to show his flashes this season, but he hasn't been able to do in a consistent fashion.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate scores long touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Carnell Tate caught 2-of-5 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Tate recorded a 59-yard touchdown in the third quarter on a play where the Cowboys defense thought he had been down near midfield. He remains a steady WR2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Carter rushes four times Sunday
items.desc: Michael Carter ran for nine yards on four carries in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys. He also caught his lone target for two yards receiving.
items.impact: Carter was elevated from the practice squad to backup Tony Pollard. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard runs for 110 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tony Pollard ran for 110 yards on 21 carries in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Pollard did not catch his lone target through the air. It was his third game with at least 100 yards in four games. He'll remain a steady RB2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Ward totals three touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Cam Ward completed 21-of-30 passes for 248 yards and two touchdowns in the Titans 51-30 loss against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Ward added another score on the ground at the goal line. On one of his touchdown passes, he connected with Carnell Tate who appeared to be down but he got up and ran into the end zone. He'll take on the Jaguars next.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bills D/ST forces interception Sunday
items.desc: The Bills defense allowed nine points on 185 total yards with one interception and two sacks on Sunday against the Dolphins.
items.impact: The Bills took advantage of the matchup against Kyle McCord. They will face Patrick Mahomes next on a short week on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Bass makes four field goals Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Bass made 4-of-5 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Bass connected on field goals from 43, 54, 40 and 28 yards out. His lone miss came from 54 yards out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dawson Knox catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Dawson Knox caught 2-of-3 targets for 31 yards in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Knox was expected to play a bigger role with Dalton Kincaid sidelined, but that did end up being the case. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keon Coleman quiet Sunday
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught 2-of-4 targets for 17 yards in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: It was DJ Moore and Khalil Shakir who far and away led the way for the Bills wide receiver room. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Khalil Shakir totals 101 yards Sunday
items.desc: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-9 targets for 101 yards in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Shakir hauled in two big gains for 38 yards and 32 yards on the day. He remains a steady WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Moore catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: DJ Moore caught 8-of-10 targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Moore led Buffalo in targets and receptions on the day, while also catching the only touchdown thrown by Josh Allen. He'll look to keep it going on a short week against the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Johnson catches seven passes Sunday
items.desc: Ty Johnson ran for two yards on one carry in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins. He also caught 7-of-8 targets for 55 yards receiving.
items.impact: Johnson was a safety blanket in the passing game out of the backfield for Josh Allen all afternoon. He still remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Cook III finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: James Cook III ran for 89 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for three yards receiving.
items.impact: Cook put together another steady day of production as he has done every week this season. He remains a steady RB1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Allen throws for 304 yards Sunday
items.desc: Josh Allen completed 27-of-45 passes for 304 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in the Bills 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Allen did not attempt a single rush all game. It was not his best performance overall as a result, though he still threw for over 300 yards. He'll take on the Chiefs next on Thursday.
